name: CreateRestoreTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination endpoint. Valid values:

RDS: an ApsaraDB RDS instance.

ECS: a self-managed database hosted on an ECS instance.

Express: a database connected over a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

Agent: a database connected via a backup gateway.

DDS: an ApsaraDB for MongoDB (DDS) instance.

Other: a database connected over the internet by using a public IP address and port.

dg: a self-managed database without a public endpoint, connected via Database Gateway
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，取值：
RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
dg：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the destination database instance.

This parameter is required when DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, `Express`, or `Agent`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例的地域。
DestinationEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination database instance.

This parameter is required when DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, or `Express`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the destination database.

This parameter is required when DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `Express`, `Agent`, or `Other`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port that is used to connect to the destination database.

This parameter is required when DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `Express`, `Agent`, `Other`, or `ECS`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other、ECS，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination database.

This parameter is required if the database engine is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The username for the destination database account.

This parameter is optional if the database engine is Redis, or if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent` and the database engine is MSSQL. In other scenarios, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password for the destination database account.

This parameter is optional if the database engine is Redis, or if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent` and the database engine is MSSQL. In other scenarios, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup gateway.

This parameter is required when DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `Agent`
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The objects to restore.

This parameter is optional if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent`. In other scenarios, this parameter is required.

The value must be a JSON string in the following format: `[{ "DBName": "source_database_name", "NewDBName": "destination_database_name" }]`

You can use this API operation to restore data only at the database level. To restore data at the table level, log on to the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85543.html
parameters.help_zh:
恢复对象。

详情请参见下面的RestoreObjects参数定义，当数据库所在位置为agent时，该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
传入模板：`[{ "DBName": "待恢复库名", "NewDBName": "目标待恢复库名" }] `

使用本API接口恢复对象仅支持恢复到数据库级别，如需配置指定表的恢复，请前往控制台进行操作。具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85543.html
parameters.name: restore_objects

parameters.help_en: The point-in-time for the restore, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the full backup set to use for the restore. The `BackupSetId` and `RestoreTime` parameters are mutually exclusive
parameters.help_zh: 恢复所使用的全量备份集ID，和RestoreTime互斥
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the restore job
parameters.help_zh: 恢复任务名称
parameters.name: restore_task_name

parameters.help_en:
The SID of the Oracle database.

This parameter is required if the database engine is Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle SID名称。

数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en: The restore directory. This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to `Agent` and the database type is MySQL
parameters.help_zh: DestinationEndpointInstanceType为agent且备份计划为MySQL时必传
parameters.name: restore_dir

parameters.help_en: The installation directory of the database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库程序目录
parameters.name: restore_home

parameters.help_en:
The policy for resolving same-name object conflicts. Valid value:

renamenew: Renames the restored object if its name conflicts with an existing object
parameters.help_zh:
同名对象冲突处理方式，当前支持：

renamenew：遇到同名对象则重命名
parameters.name: duplicate_conflict

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the source database. This parameter is required for cross-account restores
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID
parameters.name: cross_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role used for the cross-account restore
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. This token must be unique across requests
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the restore destination. Valid values:

EXIST_INSTANCE: Restores data to an existing instance.

NEW_INSTANCE: Restores data to a new instance
parameters.help_zh:
恢复至目的端方式

EXIST_INSTANCE：恢复到已有实例
NEW_INSTANCE：恢复到新建实例
parameters.name: restore_destination_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable SSL encryption to connect to the destination database
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过SSL安全加密连接目的端
parameters.name: enable_destination_endpoint_ssl

parameters.help_en: The SSL certificate used to connect to the destination database.> This parameter is required when `EnableDestinationEndpointSsl` is set to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 目的端SSL安全加密连接凭证
parameters.name: ssl_ca_pem

parameters.help_en: The type of the new instance to create for the restore.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例类型
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region where the new instance will be created.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例地域
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_region

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库专有网络
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_vpc

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例规格
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage space of the new instance. Unit: GB.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例存储大小
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_storage_size

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例交换机
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_vswitch

parameters.help_en: The database engine version of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例数据库版本
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_database_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically start the Oracle instance after restoring a physical backup. Valid values: `true` and `false`
parameters.help_zh: Oracle物理备份恢复是否自动启动实例
parameters.name: auto_open_database

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically stop the Oracle instance before restoring a physical backup. Valid values: `true` and `false`
parameters.help_zh: Oracle 物理备份恢复是否自动关闭实例
parameters.name: auto_shutdown_database
